score.summary: The Marketing department overspent its budget by the largest amount of $152,200.

result.summary: The Marketing department overspent its budget by the largest amount of $152,200.

findings.statement: Marketing had the highest overspend amount.
findings.code: SELECT b.department, (a.actual - b.budget) AS overspend FROM budget_2025_actual a JOIN budget_2025_budget b ON a.department = b.department WHERE a.actual > b.budget ORDER BY overspend DESC LIMIT 1;

data_quality_notes: No nulls or duplicates found in either table.
Budget and actual columns are integer types with no type mismatches.
assumptions: Departments in both tables are perfectly aligned.
Overspend is defined as actual spending exceeding budget.
limitations: No sampling was performed due to small dataset size (8 rows).
